author: Mark Atwood
text: Codereview pass-2 (security, kimi-k3) of 2ehk confirms this bead and sharpens the vectors: pre-created /tmp/fleet-driver-state by another local user owns burn-snapshot.json — forged recent ts suppresses evaluation forever (fleet_burn.py:78 mid-window); backdated ts + tiny usage forges a spurious ALARM + .fleet-waste marker. PID-tmp + os.replace in fleet_burn.py:38-42 only protects benign concurrent guards, not a hostile directory owner. Suggested fix matches: state under ${XDG_STATE_HOME:-$HOME/.local/state} with chmod 700, or at minimum [ -O "$STATE" ] || exit 1.
